transcript.text: Hi everyone. I've called this package-lock meeting to review the final delivery package for the live-concert documentary before I authorize delivery. Let's go through the key items: the release territory, running time, credits, and approval requirements. As a reminder, the streaming platform has requested a worldwide 68-minute master for delivery this Friday, and the documentary is currently assembled at 68 minutes. I'd like each of the responsible production leads to confirm their area and report any outstanding requirements. Once all three leads have responded, I'll issue the formal settlement action and authorization decision right here in this meeting. Let's start — could each lead please confirm the release territory, running time, credits, and approval requirements are in order, and flag anything still outstanding?
